calls.title: Demo reporting
calls.summary: The team discussed the need for cleaning and standardizing demo and contact request data for reliable reporting and pipeline tracking. Significant noise in Contact Us submissions, often due to bot entries, complicates data quality and requires manual cleanup. Current demo request tracking is hindered by multiple inconsistent forms, leading to gaps in reporting. The average demo requests show seasonal variation, with efforts to improve lead qualification focusing primarily on demo requests and large company signups. Source attribution issues stemming from lost UTM parameters during signup integration were also highlighted as critical gaps. Finally, the team emphasized ongoing process improvements, such as implementing new website forms and Slack notifications, to enhance lead management and response times.
calls.keywords: demo reporting, HubSpot forms, MQL assignment, UTM tracking, sales pipeline, form segmentation
